g.text: 4. Programming: the RP2040's boot ROM is a USB drive (RPI-RP2) - no bootloader to flash with an SWD probe. A blank board starts in it; BOOT (SW101, QSPI_SS to GND through 1k) held while plugging the cable enters it again; RESET (SW102) pulls RUN low. The SWD pads stay for debugging.

g.desc: 4. Programming: the RP2040's boot ROM is a USB drive (RPI-RP2) - no bootloader to flash with an SWD probe. A blank board starts in it; BOOT (SW101, QSPI_SS to GND through 1k) held while plugging the cable enters it again; RESET (SW102) pulls RUN low. The SWD pads stay for debugging.

g.text: Lira, wired: Raspberry Pi RP2040, USB-C only (no battery), 57 keys, built-in USB sound card

g.desc: Lira, wired: Raspberry Pi RP2040, USB-C only (no battery), 57 keys, built-in USB sound card

g.text: The wireless board (branch main: nRF52840 module, Li-Po) with the radio and the battery taken out; the RP2040 follows Raspberry Pi's 'Hardware design with RP2040' (the Pico's circuit). Differences from the wireless board:

g.desc: The wireless board (branch main: nRF52840 module, Li-Po) with the radio and the battery taken out; the RP2040 follows Raspberry Pi's 'Hardware design with RP2040' (the Pico's circuit). Differences from the wireless board:

g.text: 1. USB only, no battery: no Ebyte E73 (nRF52840) module, no Bluetooth, no Li-Po cell, no charger (MCP73831), no power path (B5819W + SI2301), no power switch, no battery divider, no 32.768 kHz crystal, no antenna keep-out.

g.desc: 1. USB only, no battery: no Ebyte E73 (nRF52840) module, no Bluetooth, no Li-Po cell, no charger (MCP73831), no power path (B5819W + SI2301), no power switch, no battery divider, no 32.768 kHz crystal, no antenna keep-out.

g.text: MICIN against the step when a plug goes in.

g.desc: MICIN against the step when a plug goes in.

g.text: 2. Raspberry Pi RP2040 instead of the module, with the minimum circuit of Raspberry Pi's 'Hardware design with RP2040' (the Pico's): 12 MHz crystal ABM8-272-T3 (the one Raspberry Pi qualified) with 2 x 15 pF and 1k in series on XOUT; W25Q128JV QSPI flash (16 MB) with a 10k pull-up on QSPI_SS; 100 nF on each of the six IOVDD pins, on both DVDD, USB_VDD and ADC_AVDD, 1 uF on

g.desc: 2. g.text: 8. Sound card: the supply switch U8 is turned on by VBUS instead of a GPIO (the wireless board has it on only in USB mode; here it always is) and its pull-down is dropped. It still soft-starts the sound card's 5 V: its 17 uF are charged through the switch's controlled rise, not straight from the cable (only ~3 uF sit directly on VBUS). The amplifier's EN delay (1M + 470 nF)

It still soft-starts the sound card's 5 V: its 17 uF are charged through the switch's controlled rise, not straight from the cable (only ~3 uF sit directly on VBUS).
